description:
Change the account's DEFAULT voice, affecting every reminder without an override.

    For a single reminder only, use set_reminder_voice instead. Get valid IDs from
    list_voices; preview_voice lets the user hear one first.

    Args:
        voice_id: Voice ID from list_voices.
        personality: "gentle", "cheerful", "professional", or "energetic".
        language: BCP-47 tag, e.g. "en-US", "en-GB", "hi-IN".
        speaking_rate: 0.8 (slower — often better for elderly listeners) to 1.2 (faster).
        greet_by_name: Whether calls open by greeting the user by name.
name: set_voice_settings
title: Set default voice
